post_title: How many advance votes will the NZ Electoral Commission report for Thursday 29 October 2026 (daily count, day 4 of advance voting)?

question.title: How many advance votes will the NZ Electoral Commission report for Thursday 29 October 2026 (daily count, day 4 of advance voting)?
question.description:
New Zealand holds its 2026 General Election on Saturday 7 November 2026. Advance (early) voting runs for 12 days, from Monday 26 October to Friday 6 November 2026 (https://vote.nz/2026-general-election/about/overview/key-dates). Thursday 29 October 2026 is the fourth day of advance voting.

During advance voting the Electoral Commission publishes daily and cumulative advance-voting statistics, updated each day. In 2023 these appeared on a "Voting statistics" page at vote.nz and elections.nz, updated each day from the day after voting opened until election day; the data is "collected informally from voting places each day and may not match official results" and excludes overseas votes (https://vote.nz/2023-general-election/about/2023-general-election/voting-statistics). The daily figures shown live during the period are ordinary votes; the 2023 table was only later (February 2024) updated to add special votes.

For calibration: 2023 advance voting also ran 12 days (Monday 2 October to Friday 13 October 2023, with election day on the second Saturday, 14 October), so its day-by-day timeline aligns with 2026. Total 2023 advance votes were 1,640,204 (ordinary + special, after the retrospective update), versus 1,976,996 in 2020 and 1,240,740 in 2017. Daily figures started lower on the opening Monday and built through the week; the first Thursday (day 4) was in the low-hundreds-of-thousands per day range relative to the roughly 1.4 million ordinary-vote 12-day total.

Context differs in 2026: a law change closed enrolment on Sunday 25 October 2026, removing election-day and advance-period enrolment (in 2023 about 450,000 people enrolled during the voting period). About 3.64 million voters were enrolled as of late September 2026 (~89.8% of an estimated 4,051,640 eligible). These factors make the daily pace for day 4 genuinely uncertain.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the number of advance votes the New Zealand Electoral Commission reports as cast (issued) on Thursday 29 October 2026 — the fourth day of advance voting for the 2026 General Election — as shown in the daily (not cumulative) advance voting statistics table published on the Electoral Commission's voting-statistics page for the 2026 General Election (expected at https://vote.nz/ and https://elections.nz/ , analogous to the 2023 page at https://vote.nz/2023-general-election/about/2023-general-election/voting-statistics ). The value is the single-day figure listed against the date 29 October 2026 as displayed on that page at the time of resolution (for example, a reported daily figure of 125,432 resolves as 125432). If the Commission's daily table shows separate ordinary and special-vote figures for that date at the time of resolution, use the combined total; if it shows ordinary votes only, use that figure.
question.fine_print: These statistics are collected informally from voting places each day and may differ from later official results; the informally reported daily figure for 29 October 2026, as displayed on the Commission's voting-statistics page (or an equivalent daily advance-voting table published by the Electoral Commission) at the time of resolution, is what counts. Later retrospective additions to that date's figure (for example, special votes added to the historical table months after the election, as happened for 2023 in February 2024) do not change the resolution. Overseas votes are excluded, consistent with the Commission's published advance-voting statistics. If the Electoral Commission does not publish a daily advance-voting figure for 29 October 2026 anywhere by the resolution date, the question is annulled.
